Nora (Product): Heads-up: we're opening a small pilot for the On-Prem Offline Recovery Kit (ORK) today. ORK bundles a customer-controlled repair image, signed attestations, and a documented manual recovery flow for air-gapped/private deployments. Pilot = 4 customers. Signup doc: https://intranet.redwood/ork-preview :seedling:
Ibrahim (DevOps): Tech notes: ORK is offline-first. Customers receive a signed tarball + SBOM and an offline verifier tool. No outbound connections required. Recommend a weekly 2-hour maintenance window for applying the kit and running verification.
Priya (Security): Security constraints: we will only ship signed artifacts; signing keys are HSM-backed. Audit materials (signed SBOM, attestation metadata) are provided to the customer. For the pilot we will retain only the artifact hashes and verification results for 14 days, per pilot telemetry policy.
Ava (CS): I'll reach out to the four customers we've pre-identified. Need a short FAQ and rollback steps. Nora, can you post a one-page customer-facing summary?
Nora (Product): Draft one-pager here: https://docs.redwood/ork/pilot-summary 99please review by EOD Tuesday. Policy note: if ORK pilot goes GA, we'll add an optional "expedited remote repair" opt-in that requires explicit written consent. No changes to default offline flow. :information_source:
legal-bot: Reminder: any consent language that changes customer obligations must be reviewed by Legal. Please ping Legal when you have the final draft.
Priya (Security): Action: add ORK to the SOC artifacts pipeline and prepare an attestation template for customers that need it for audits.
Ibrahim (DevOps): Pilot plan: week 0 invite -> week 1 verification runs -> week 2 dry-run recoveries -> week 3 feedback + GA checklist. Automatic health checks will run after application; rollback instructions included in the kit.
Ava (CS): Customer note draft: "ORK gives you a customer-controlled offline repair option. Opting into the expedited remote repair requires separate consent; ORK remains offline by default." I'll tailor per account.
Nora (Product): If anyone has objections to the 2-hour weekly maintenance window recommendation, reply here before EOD Friday. Otherwise we'll finalize pilot invites tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
